title: Active & Passive Voice
description: Syntactic shift focusing either on the doer or recipient of the action.
coreRuleSummary: Ensure tense retention with appropriate be-verb + V3 form across assertions, imperatives, and interrogatives.

title: Direct & Indirect Speech
description: Reporting spoken statements without altering original meaning or intent.
coreRuleSummary: Apply pronoun adjustments (SON rule), backshift tenses, update time/place anchors, and select precise reporting verbs.

title: Modal Auxiliaries
description: Helping verbs indicating mood, ability, obligation, probability, or permission.
coreRuleSummary: Master distinction between should/must/ought to, semi-modals dare/need, and past speculation structures.

title: Prepositions & Fixed Collocations
description: Spatial, temporal, and fixed prepositional attachments to verbs and adjectives.
coreRuleSummary: Learn established combinations (abstain from, senior to, die of), avoid unnecessary prepositions after transitive verbs.

title: Subject-Verb Agreement
description: The singular/plural concord between subjects and finite verbs in sentences.
coreRuleSummary: Identify the true subject, disregard prepositional modifiers, follow proximity rules with either/or, and recognize collective noun units.

title: Tenses & Time Markers
description: The 12 tenses describing state and progression across past, present, and future.
coreRuleSummary: Coordinate main and subordinate clause tenses, adhere to since/for rules, and avoid past perfect overuse.
